newsitem.title: SYRIA: Iran's Velayati in Syria with message for Assad.
newsitem.headline: Iran's Velayati in Syria with message for Assad.

text.p: Iranian Foreign Minister Ali Akbar Velayati arrived from Beirut on Wednesday for talks with Syrian leaders on the latest developments in the region.

Velayati told reporters on arrival he was carrying a message for Syrian President Hafez al-Assad from his Iranian counterpart, Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani, dealing with the Middle East situation and bilateral ties.
"Ties between Syria and Iran are brotherly and close. I will exchange views with my colleague (Syrian Foreign Minister) Farouq al-Shara on latest developments in the region," he said.
"It is important to convey to our Syrian brothers the outcome of my tour to coordinate and discuss our joint future moves," Velayati said.
Diplomats said Velayati's talks in Syria would cover the situation in south Lebanon where pro-Iranian Shi'ite guerrillas are fighting Israel's occupation of the area.
Syria is the main foreign power broker in Lebanon where it has some 35,000 troops.

While in Beirut, Velayati gave President Elias Hrawi an invitation to attend an Islamic summit in Tehran in December. He presented a similar invitation to Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak earlier in the week.
Both presidents accepted the invitations, as did Assad during a Velayati visit to Damascus last month.
